_readme: Single source of truth for which code projects this repo's CI covers, how, and why.
Consumed by scripts/ci-coverage.mjs (list-apps / app-config / validate-inventory) and
by .github/workflows/ci.yml's sub-app-checks matrix. Do not duplicate this app list
Each app's 'checks' entry may be: {command, required, exception?} for a real check,
or {command: null, required: false, status: 'not_implemented', note} where no real
check exists yet. An 'exception' records a specific, currently-tolerated failure:
{issue, owner, recorded, expires, failure_signature, removal_condition}. The CI
evaluator only tolerates a failure whose captured output contains failure_signature;
any other failure of that step is treated as real and fails the run regardless of
Node runtime: all entries below run on the single node_version at the top of this
on 2026-09-21: v20 (Iron) end=2026-04-30, already past end of life; v22 (Jod)
maintenance since 2025-10-21, end=2027-04-30, still supported but past Active LTS;
v24 (Krypton) lts since 2025-10-28, still in Active LTS (maintenance starts
2026-10-20), end=2028-04-30. v24 is the current Active LTS and is used here; it also
satisfies docs/site's real toolchain requirement (Astro 7.3.2 needs >=22.12.0).

test.note: Runs the app's own existing composite script (starts server, Playwright e2e, Lighthouse CI, stops server) rather than reimplementing it here. #1296 was actually a missing browser-install step (no `setup`, unlike web-mvp/demo-288/demos-288-template-customization), not a genuine test-content failure as originally logged — job logs show `browserType.launch: Executable doesn't exist at .../chromium_headless_shell-1243/...`, the exact pattern F4 already fixed for the other two Playwright apps in this repo.

build.note: #1295's ERESOLVE conflict (@typescript-eslint/eslint-plugin@7 vs eslint@9) fixed by bumping typescript-eslint to 8. Fixing install surfaced that this app had no eslint/tsc/jest config at all and most of its package.json scripts referenced an API server, dashboard, and DB migrations that were never written — see #1311. build/lint/test now run for real against what actually exists (src/sdk/).
Validates JavaScript syntax, stages native ESM in dist/, and imports the distribution entry point. Fails on invalid syntax or unresolved entry-point imports.

test.note: Jest ESM tests cover engine execution, validation, retries, HTTP integration, and build failure cases. No passWithNoTests bypass.

lint.note: Fixed: eslintConfig.extends used "@typescript-eslint/recommended" (missing the required plugin: prefix), so ESLint tried to resolve it as a package name and failed.

build.note: Fixed: tsconfig include swept tests/ into the production build's rootDir=src program (TS6059); added a declare module 'asana' ambient declaration (the package ships no types); fixed several exactOptionalPropertyTypes violations and a node-cron v2→v4 API mismatch ({ scheduled: false } / .getNextDates() don't exist in the installed v4); added a missing modified_at field to AsanaTask that the code's own API calls already request via opt_fields.

test.note: SDK compatibility repaired in #1287: a shared adapter uses the installed Asana v2 callback API, request envelopes, response data, and query arrays. Tests exercise the real SDK against a local HTTP server, including authentication errors and bounded rate-limit retries. Tracks #1312.

template-selector-mvp.path: PM Tools Templates - Q3 2025 Delivery Cycle/Implementation/template-selector

build.note: Root cause of the original install failure: cypress@^16.1.0 conflicted with cypress-axe@1.7.0's peer range (cypress ^10-^15, no newer cypress-axe exists yet); downgraded to cypress@^15.21.1. That surfaced two further real bugs: fuse.js used in src/hooks/useTemplates.ts but never declared as a dependency (added), and EnhancedTemplatePreview.tsx importing a EnhancedTemplatePreview.css that never existed (added, following sibling TemplatePreview.css's conventions).

test.note: Frontend's own test script (package.json's plain `test`); the nested backend/ is a separate npm project with its own dependency tree, covered independently as template-selector-backend. tests/backend-integration.test.js required ../backend/server (and transitively express, only present in backend/'s own node_modules) - moved to backend/tests/ where it can actually resolve its dependencies.
